title: Add a backup server (failover)
q: keep site online if server goes down
intro: Run the project on a second server. Every deploy goes to both, and Rover switches visitors to the backup if the main server stops answering (with Cloudflare).
intro_hi: प्रोजेक्ट को दूसरे सर्वर पर भी चलाएँ; मुख्य सर्वर बंद हो तो Rover विज़िटर्स को बैकअप पर भेज देता है।

steps.say: Click Add a backup server (or + Add another server).
Pick the server: another rented one, a machine at home, or This PC.
Keep Primary + backup and click Add server, then confirm.
Done. The table shows each server's version and health. Automatic switching needs the domain on Cloudflare.

title: Host on this PC
intro: Rover's built-in web server can serve your sites from this Windows PC, reachable from the internet through a Cloudflare tunnel. Best as a backup.
intro_hi: Rover इसी Windows PC से आपकी साइट चला सकता है। बैकअप के लिए सबसे अच्छा।

steps.say: Tick Serve websites from this PC.
Keep the PC awake while it hosts (recommended), and Start with Windows.
To be reachable from the internet, click Connect to the internet (needs Cloudflare).
This PC can now be added to a project as a backup server in the project's Hosting tab.

title: Update Rover
intro: Rover checks for new versions. Updates are signed and verified before they install; your projects and settings stay.

steps.say: If a new version is shown, click Install. Rover restarts by itself after a few seconds.
Tip: tick automatic updates so you never have to do this again.

title: Give Jiv an offline brain (AI)
intro: Jiv already works offline with built-in help. The offline brain is a free AI model that runs on this PC so Jiv understands any wording and can plan tasks. Nothing goes to the internet.
intro_hi: ऑफ़लाइन ब्रेन एक मुफ़्त AI मॉडल है जो इसी PC पर चलता है। इंटरनेट पर कुछ नहीं जाता।

steps.say: Rover checked this PC (memory and graphics card) and marked the best model as Recommended.
Click Download offline brain. About 1-3 GB, verified, resumable. Or use Import offline pack if you have the file on a USB drive.
Jiv now answers free-form questions and plans multi-step tasks on this PC. Cloud AI (ChatGPT, Claude...) is optional in Settings > Connect AI.

title: Import an offline pack (no internet)
intro: An offline pack (.dlpack file, from the full installer's download page or another PC) contains the AI engine and model. Importing it needs no internet.

steps.say: This card lists offline packs Rover found next to the app and on USB drives.
Click Import a pack, choose the .dlpack file (or the first part, .dlpack.001) and confirm.
